mapper.insert: insert into points_exchange (user_id, goods_id, points_spent, status, receive_info) values (#{userId}, #{goodsId}, #{pointsSpent}, #{status}, #{receiveInfo})
mapper.select: select e.*, g.name as goodsName, g.image as goodsImage from points_exchange e left join points_goods g on e.goods_id = g.id where e.user_id = #{userId} order by e.create_time desc
